description: World Bank Microdata Library with household, firm, and other survey microdata and documentation, including access conditions that vary from open download to registration.

name: World Bank Open Data
description: Free and open access to global development data from the World Bank, including World Development Indicators and thousands of country, regional, and global indicators with bulk download and API access.

name: World Bank Projects and Operations
description: World Bank Projects and Operations portal listing active and closed lending projects, contract awards, procurement notices, and results, with search filters and API access.

name: World Customs Organization (WCO)
description: Intergovernmental body maintaining the Harmonized System tariff nomenclature and publishing customs facilitation standards and guidance.

name: World Energy Council
description: Global energy forum with member committees in many countries, publishing scenario studies, energy trilemma country assessments, and reports on energy transition issues.

name: World Federation of Exchanges (WFE)
description: World Federation of Exchanges, the global association of market operators, publishing annual and monthly exchange statistics on trading volumes, listings, and market capitalization.

name: World Food Programme
description: United Nations agency delivering food assistance in emergencies, publishing needs assessments, market monitoring, and the HungerMap for food security tracking.

name: World Health Organization
description: United Nations health agency publishing health guidelines, disease outbreak news, country health profiles, and global health statistics.

name: World Inequality Database
description: Database on income and wealth inequality compiled by the World Inequality Lab, combining distributional data from surveys, tax records, and national accounts.

name: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)
description: United Nations agency that administers international intellectual property treaties, provides policy resources, and operates services for patents, trademarks, and designs.

name: World Meteorological Organization
description: United Nations specialized agency for meteorology, climatology, hydrology, and related geophysical sciences, coordinating standards and observation programmes across national weather services.
best_for: state of the global climate reports

name: World Nuclear Association (WNA)
description: World Nuclear Association, the industry body for nuclear power, publishing country nuclear power profiles, fuel cycle information, reactor performance data, and safety reports.

name: World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS)
description: World Register of Marine Species, an editorially verified taxonomic database of marine species names with classification, distribution notes, and links to other biodiversity resources.

name: World Values Survey
description: Global research project repeated in waves since 1981 measuring values, beliefs, and attitudes across societies, with questionnaires and data files available through its site.
access_requirements: Free account required to download data files.

name: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
description: International community that develops open web standards such as HTML, CSS, WCAG, and XML, with specifications, drafts, and group documents publicly available.

name: WorldCat
description: Public catalog of library collections worldwide maintained by OCLC, letting users locate books, journals, and other items and find libraries that hold them.

name: WorldCat
description: Union catalog from OCLC that searches the collections of thousands of libraries worldwide and shows which libraries hold a given item.

name: WorldPop
description: University of Southampton program producing high-resolution open gridded population estimates, age and sex structure rasters, and demographic projections.

name: Worldview
description: Interactive browser for near real time and historical global satellite imagery from NASA Earth observing instruments, with image export and layer controls.

name: WRAP: Warwick Research Archive Portal
description: WRAP is the University of Warwick's research archive portal for publications, theses, and datasets, with open access where rights permit.

name: WTO Data
description: World Trade Organization statistical portal for merchandise trade, commercial services, tariffs, and indicators with downloadable time series and API access.

name: WTO dispute settlement
description: World Trade Organization pages on the dispute settlement system, listing disputes by country and status with panel and Appellate Body reports and agreement texts.

name: WTO Documents Online
description: Official World Trade Organization repository providing access to member submissions, notifications, reports, and meeting records.

name: WTO Statistics
description: World Trade Organization statistical portal with merchandise trade and commercial services statistics, tariff data, trade profiles, and indicators for members and other economies.

name: X-MOL
description: Chinese research platform for literature tracking and journal awareness with strength in chemistry, offering journal feeds, paper search, and science career information in Chinese and English.

name: Yad Vashem
description: World center for Holocaust research, documentation, education, and commemoration with a large digital archive of names and documents.

name: YODA Project
description: Yale School of Medicine clinical data sharing initiative that brokers requests for clinical trial data from industry and academic sponsors, housing data packages under registered data use agreements.
access_requirements: Registered data use agreement required

name: zbMATH Open
description: Open access reviewing and abstracting database for mathematics literature operated by FIZ Karlsruhe, covering publications in pure and applied mathematics with reviewer metadata.

name: Zenodo
description: General purpose open repository operated by CERN that hosts publications, preprints, datasets, software, and reports with persistent identifiers and a public REST API.

name: Zero Day Initiative (ZDI)
description: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure program publishing advisories with CVSS scores and vendor timelines for bugs submitted by researchers.

name: Zindi
description: Data science competition platform for Africa hosting challenges with datasets focused on regional social and business problems.

name: Zooniverse
description: Platform for people powered research that hosts citizen science projects in which volunteers classify images, transcribe records, and contribute data to academic studies.

name: ZORA
description: ZORA (Zurich Open Repository and Archive) is the University of Zurich's repository for publications, theses, and research data, with open access where possible.

name: Zotero
description: Free open source reference manager for collecting, organizing, citing, and sharing research sources, with browser capture and group libraries.

name: ZoteroBib
description: Free web citation generator from the Zotero team that builds bibliographies in many styles from DOIs, URLs, ISBNs, and titles without an account.
